outputs.location: Section titled 'DATA AVAILABILITY' immediately after the Methods section and before Acknowledgments
outputs.issues: The DAS is present but not formatted per the journal's required style. Problems: 1) Entries are not given as separate bullet points; instead they are short paragraphs. 2) Each accession is missing an explicit measurement type label (e.g., 'Cryo-EM maps:' or 'Atomic models:'). 3) Not all entries include clearly resolvable links in a consistent form — the EMD-40772 link appears malformed (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/emdb/EMD-4077 should likely be EMD-40772), and the PDB link points to an 'unreleased' URL (https://www.rcsb.org/structure/unreleased/8SUP) rather than a public PDB record or DOI. 4) The statement about plasmids being 'available by request' does not indicate deposition in a public repository (e.g., Addgene). 5) The DAS does not use the recommended per-dataset structured lines (measurement type; repository name/acronym; accession/DOI; resolvable link).
